behavior: Read the old output pointer first. A nonzero value emits the native MallocFAILED diagnostic but allocation continues without freeing the old block.
PoolID is flags&3. Bit10hex requests the pinned flag;bit20hex preserves the old output only on failure. Other flag bits do not become descriptor flags.

Write allocation descriptor and owner word,emit the allocation diagnostic,then update the output slot and return the payload. Failure returns0 and clears the output unless bit20hex is set.
Owner/header/metadata aliases preserve native mutation order,even when the resulting heap/ownership is malformed. No new validation or repair is introduced.
